Projects.Name: Amazon.Lambda.Core
ChangelogMessages: Add ILambdaContext.W3C to expose the W3C trace-context fields (traceparent, tracestate, baggage) carried on clientContext.w3c at invoke time.

Projects.Name: Amazon.Lambda.RuntimeSupport
ChangelogMessages: Implement ILambdaContext.W3C in LambdaContext, surfacing the allowlisted W3C trace-context fields (traceparent, tracestate, baggage) parsed from the client context header.

Projects.Name: Amazon.Lambda.TestUtilities
ChangelogMessages: Add W3C trace-context support to TestLambdaContext via the settable W3CFields property and the W3C property.

Projects.Name: Amazon.Lambda.AspNetCoreServer
ChangelogMessages: Implement ILambdaContext.W3C on the SnapStart empty context, returning an empty trace-context during initialization.
